Name: (CP) Cerri's working televisions CES
Author: CerridwynMorgana
Description:
Replaces vanilla game televisions with televisions that coordinate with other Cerri's mods .

Because my mod directly replaces the game plasma and budget tvs, this mod is not compatible with other mods that replace the plasma and budget tvs, including my other tv mod, Cerri's working televisions . 

Functions as a regular plasma tv but is the central piece of Cerri's entertainment center (CES)

Downloads.Description: Working tvs that coordinate with other Cerri's mods and the plasma tv is the centre piece for Cerri's entertainment stand (CES).
